pipelines.name: Artifact Hub metadata

steps.name: Check the repository ID is set
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

# Artifact Hub ignores metadata whose ID does not match, and says
# nothing about it: the badge simply never appears. Failing here is
# the only feedback there is.
id=$(awk '$1 == "repositoryID:" { print $2 }' artifacthub-repo.yml)

if [[ ! "$id" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::artifacthub-repo.yml has repositoryID '$id', which is not the UUID Artifact Hub shows on the repository's card in the control panel."
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Log in to GHCR
steps.run:
echo "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | \
  oras login ghcr.io -u ${{ github.actor }} --password-stdin

steps.name: Push the metadata
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

oras push "${REPOSITORY}:artifacthub.io" \
  --config /dev/null:application/vnd.cncf.artifacthub.config.v1+yaml \
  artifacthub-repo.yml:application/vnd.cncf.artifacthub.repository-metadata.layer.v1.yaml

pipelines.name: Backport

steps.name: Refuse breaking changes
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
message=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/commits/$SHA" --jq .commit.message)
if [[ "$(head -n 1 <<< "$message")" =~ ^[a-z]+(\([^\)]*\))?!: ]] ||
   grep -qE '^BREAKING[ -]CHANGE:' <<< "$message"; then
  msg="This PR is a breaking change, so it is not backported. A maintenance branch only takes changes that keep existing installs working. If part of it applies there, open a PR against the maintenance branch directly."
  gh pr comment "$PR" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --body "$msg"
  echo "::error::$msg"
  exit 1
fi

pipelines.name: Bump n8n version

steps.name: Resolve current version
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

# Only from the default branch. workflow_dispatch lets the caller pick
# any ref, and a bump PR built from an arbitrary branch's workflow is
# not something to hand auto-merge. Loud rather than a job-level `if`,
# which would skip a mistaken dispatch green and say nothing.
if [[ "$GITHUB_REF" != "refs/heads/main" ]]; then
  echo "::error::this job only runs from main, but $GITHUB_REF was dispatched."
  exit 1
fi

# A version is one line's decision. Applied to every line it would
# cross a major on all but one of them.
if [[ -n "$REQUESTED" && "$LINE_INPUT" == "all" ]]; then
  echo "::error::a version was given for every line. Pick the one line it is for."
  exit 1
fi

# Git cannot hold automated/bump-n8n alongside automated/bump-n8n/...,
# so a maintenance line's branch flattens the line into the name.
if [[ "$LINE" == "main" ]]; then
  branch=automated/bump-n8n
else
  branch="automated/bump-n8n-${LINE//\//-}"
fi
echo "BRANCH=$branch" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

current=$(awk '$1 == "appVersion:" { gsub(/"/, "", $2); print $2 }' charts/n8n/Chart.yaml)
if [[ ! "$current" =~ ^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::charts/n8n/Chart.yaml appVersion is '$current', not a concrete version, so there is nothing to compare against."
  exit 1
fi
echo "version=$current" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Current: $current"

steps.name: Resolve target version
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

version_re='^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$'
IFS=. read -r cur_major cur_minor cur_patch <<< "$CURRENT"

if [[ -n "${REQUESTED:-}" ]]; then
  target=$REQUESTED
  source="the version input"
else
  # The git tag refs/tags/stable is a different object and points at a
  # prerelease. The stable release's target_commitish is the release
  # branch, for example release/2.38.6.
  target=$(gh api repos/n8n-io/n8n/releases/tags/stable --jq .target_commitish | sed 's|^release/||')
  source="n8n's stable release"

  # Once stable has moved to a newer major, this line follows the
  # newest release still in its own. n8n publishes its beta builds as
  # GitHub prereleases, so leaving those out leaves the releases that
  # were stable in their time. Patch releases of an older minor can be
  # published after a newer minor, so this takes the highest version,
  # not the most recent.
  if [[ "$target" =~ $version_re ]] && (( 10#${target%%.*} > 10#$cur_major )); then
    target=$(gh api --paginate 'repos/n8n-io/n8n/releases?per_page=100' \
      --jq ".[] | select(.prerelease == false and .draft == false) | .tag_name | select(test(\"^n8n@${cur_major}\\\\.[0-9]+\\\\.[0-9]+$\")) | ltrimstr(\"n8n@\")" |
      sort -t. -k1,1n -k2,2n -k3,3n | tail -n 1)
    source="the highest n8n ${cur_major}.x release, as stable is on a newer major,"
  fi
fi

if [[ ! "$target" =~ $version_re ]]; then
  echo "::error::$source resolved to '$target', which is not a concrete version."
  exit 1
fi

IFS=. read -r new_major new_minor new_patch <<< "$target"

# A string compare is exact here because the format check above
# rejects a zero-padded field, so 2 and 02 cannot both reach this.
if [[ "$new_major" != "$cur_major" ]]; then
  echo "::error::$source is $target, which crosses a major from $CURRENT. An n8n major needs chart changes of its own, so this job will not do it."
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "$target" == "$CURRENT" ]]; then
  echo "Already on $CURRENT, nothing to do."
  echo "changed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi

# 10# in case the format check is ever loosened: without it a
# zero-padded field would be read as octal, and 08 is not valid octal.
if (( 10#$new_minor < 10#$cur_minor ||
      (10#$new_minor == 10#$cur_minor && 10#$new_patch < 10#$cur_patch) )); then
  echo "::error::$source is $target, which is behind $CURRENT. This job only moves forwards; run scripts/bump-n8n-version.sh by hand for a rollback."
  exit 1
fi

# release-please takes the chart increment from the commit type, so it
# follows the size of the n8n move.
if (( 10#$new_minor > 10#$cur_minor )); then
  type=feat
else
  type=fix
fi

{
  echo "version=$target"
  echo "type=$type"
  echo "changed=true"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

echo "Bumping $CURRENT to $target as $type(chart)"

steps.name: Rewrite version pins
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
scripts/bump-n8n-version.sh "$VERSION"
git --no-pager diff --stat
# The PR body lists what actually moved rather than a prose list that
# would go stale the moment the set of pinned files changes. The
# checkout above is clean, so this and the commit below both see the
# script's rewrites and nothing else.
{
  echo "files<<PINNED_FILES"
  git diff --name-only
  echo "PINNED_FILES"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Push bump branch
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git config user.name "${APP_SLUG}[bot]"
git config user.email "${APP_SLUG}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
git commit --all --message "$TYPE(chart): bump n8n to $VERSION"
# A fixed branch, force pushed, so a stale open bump PR is updated
# rather than a second one opened alongside it. The branch belongs to
# this job: it is rebuilt from its line every run, so anything pushed
# onto it by hand is discarded next Wednesday. Fix a red bump PR on its
# own branch, not on this one. No --force-with-lease for the same
# reason, a lease would stall the weekly bump on someone else's commit.
git push --force "https://x-access-token:$GH_TOKEN@github.com/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" "HEAD:refs/heads/$BRANCH"

steps.name: Open or update PR
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

title="$TYPE(chart): bump n8n to $VERSION"

# This lands on the line as the squash commit body, so it stays to the
# facts. Nothing in it is footer shaped, which would otherwise let the
# body override the increment the title asks for.
body=$(cat <<EOF
Moves the pinned n8n version from $CURRENT to $VERSION.

Updated:
$FILES

Release notes for $VERSION: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n/releases/tag/n8n%40$VERSION
EOF
)

# --head matches on branch name alone, so a fork PR whose head branch
# is also called automated/bump-n8n would come back here and get
# retitled, relabelled and handed auto-merge. Only ever act on a PR
# from this repository. Qualifying --head as owner:branch does not
# work, it matches nothing at all, so filter on the PR instead.
pr=$(gh pr list --head "$BRANCH" --base "$LINE" --state open \
  --json number,isCrossRepository \
  --jq 'map(select(.isCrossRepository == false)) | .[0].number // empty')

if [[ -z "$pr" ]]; then
  # gh prints the new PR's URL, which the merge step takes as readily
  # as a number and avoids listing again to find out what we just made.
  # The label is for humans reading the PR: gh applies labels after
  # the PR exists, so it is not in the `opened` event and does not by
  # itself make install-test run. ci.yml's gate job does that, off the
  # branch name, so install-test runs from the opened event onwards.
  pr=$(gh pr create --base "$LINE" --head "$BRANCH" --title "$title" --body "$body" --label test-install)
else
  gh pr edit "$pr" --title "$title" --body "$body" --add-label test-install
fi

if [[ -z "$pr" ]]; then
  echo "::error::the PR was neither found nor created, so there is nothing to auto-merge."
  exit 1
fi

echo "pr=$pr" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Enable auto-merge
steps.run: gh pr merge --auto --squash "$PR"

pipelines.name: CI

steps.name: List the examples install-test covers
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
examples=()
upgrades=()
for overlay in charts/n8n/ci/install/*.yaml; do
  example=$(basename "$overlay" .yaml)
  previous="previous/charts/n8n/ci/install/${example}.yaml"
  if [[ "$HAS_LICENCE" != "true" ]] && grep -qs 'name: n8n-license' "$overlay" "$previous"; then
    echo "::notice::Skipping the ${example} install and upgrade legs: the licence secrets are not available."
    continue
  fi
  examples+=("$example")
  if [[ -f "$previous" ]]; then
    upgrades+=("$example")
  fi
done
for previous in previous/charts/n8n/ci/install/*.yaml; do
  example=$(basename "$previous" .yaml)
  if [[ ! -f "charts/n8n/ci/install/${example}.yaml" ]]; then
    echo "::notice::No upgrade leg for ${example}: this branch has no overlay for it."
  fi
done
json=$(printf '%s\n' "${examples[@]}" | jq -R 'select(length > 0)' | jq -sc .)
echo "examples=$json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "install-test examples: $json"
json=$(printf '%s\n' "${upgrades[@]}" | jq -R 'select(length > 0)' | jq -sc .)
echo "upgrade-examples=$json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "upgrade-test examples: $json"

steps.name: Decide whether install-test runs
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

versions=()
if [[ "$EVENT" == "pull_request" ]]; then
  if [[ "$LABELLED" == "true" ]]; then
    versions+=(appVersion)
  elif [[ "$SAME_REPO" == "true" ]] &&
       [[ "$HEAD_REF" == automated/bump-n8n* || "$HEAD_REF" == release-please--* ]]; then
    versions+=(appVersion)
  fi

  # The dated tag that v3-rc points at, so the run names the build it
  # tested. Both images publish the same tags, and the runner image
  # follows image.tag.
  if [[ "$V3_RC_LABELLED" == "true" && "$BASE_REF" == "main" ]]; then
    hub=https://hub.docker.com/v2/repositories
    digest=$(curl -sSf "$hub/n8nio/n8n/tags/v3-rc" | jq -r .digest)
    tag=$(curl -sSf "$hub/n8nio/n8n/tags?page_size=100&name=v3-rc-" |
      jq -r --arg digest "$digest" '[.results[]
        | select(.digest == $digest and (.name | test("^v3-rc-[0-9]{8}(\\.[0-9]+)?$")))
        | .name] | sort | last // empty')
    if [[ -z "$tag" ]]; then
      echo "::error::No dated n8n tag matches v3-rc ($digest)."
      exit 1
    fi
    if ! curl -sSf -o /dev/null "$hub/n8nio/runners/tags/$tag"; then
      echo "::error::n8nio/runners has no $tag tag to match n8nio/n8n."
      exit 1
    fi
    echo "v3-rc is $tag."
    versions+=("$tag")
  fi
fi

run=false
if [[ ${#versions[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
  run=true
fi
json=$(printf '%s\n' "${versions[@]}" | jq -R 'select(length > 0)' | jq -sc .)
echo "install-test=$run" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "install-n8n=$json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "install-test on this event: $run, on n8n $json"

# Only main is a major ahead of UPGRADE_FROM. A maintenance branch
# has no newer major to upgrade to.
upgrade=false
if [[ "$EVENT" == "pull_request" && "$UPGRADE_LABELLED" == "true" && "$BASE_REF" == "main" && "$UPGRADE_EXAMPLES" != "[]" ]]; then
  upgrade=true
fi

echo "upgrade-test=$upgrade" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "upgrade-test on this event: $upgrade"

steps.name: Run chart-testing (lint)
steps.run: ct lint --chart-dirs charts --charts charts/n8n --validate-maintainers=false

steps.name: Install helm-unittest
steps.run: helm plugin install https://github.com/helm-unittest/helm-unittest.git --version v1.1.2

steps.name: Run unit tests
steps.run: helm unittest --strict charts/n8n

steps.name: Run unit tests without schema validation
steps.run: helm unittest --strict --skip-schema-validation -f 'tests/without-schema/*_test.yaml' charts/n8n

steps.name: Render every example
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

failed=0
for f in charts/n8n/examples/*.yaml; do
  echo "Rendering $f"
  if ! helm template test charts/n8n -f "$f" --dry-run=client > /dev/null; then
    echo "::error file=$f::$f does not render."
    failed=1
  fi
done

exit "$failed"

steps.name: Validate extraContainers (minimal + ci overlay)
steps.run: helm template test charts/n8n -f charts/n8n/examples/minimal.yaml -f charts/n8n/ci/extraContainers-values.yaml --dry-run=client > /dev/null

steps.name: Install yq
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
curl -sSfL -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/yq" "https://github.com/mikefarah/yq/releases/download/v${YQ_VERSION}/yq_linux_amd64"
echo "${YQ_SHA256}  $RUNNER_TEMP/yq" | sha256sum -c -
chmod +x "$RUNNER_TEMP/yq"
echo "YQ=$RUNNER_TEMP/yq" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
grep -qx "YQ_TESTED_VERSION=\"${YQ_VERSION}\"" charts/n8n/scripts/migrate-values.sh ||
  { echo "::error::YQ_VERSION here and YQ_TESTED_VERSION in migrate-values.sh differ."; exit 1; }

steps.name: Run the migrate-values tests
steps.run: bash charts/n8n/tests/migrate-values/run.sh

steps.name: Migrate and render every example from ${{ env.PREVIOUS }}
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

failed=0
for f in previous/charts/n8n/examples/*.yaml; do
  name=$(basename "$f")
  echo "Migrating $name"
  if ! bash charts/n8n/scripts/migrate-values.sh "$f" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/$name"; then
    echo "::error::migrate-values.sh failed on ${PREVIOUS}'s $name."
    failed=1
    continue
  fi
  if ! helm template test charts/n8n -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/$name" --dry-run=client > /dev/null; then
    echo "::error::${PREVIOUS}'s $name, migrated, does not render."
    failed=1
  fi
done

exit "$failed"

steps.name: Install kubeconform
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
curl -sSfLo kubeconform.tar.gz "https://github.com/yannh/kubeconform/releases/download/${KUBECONFORM_VERSION}/kubeconform-linux-amd64.tar.gz"
echo "${KUBECONFORM_SHA256}  kubeconform.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf kubeconform.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin kubeconform
rm kubeconform.tar.gz
kubeconform -v

steps.name: Validate every example
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

minimum=$(grep -E '^kubeVersion:' charts/n8n/Chart.yaml | grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | head -1 || true)
if [[ -z "$minimum" ]]; then
  echo "::error file=charts/n8n/Chart.yaml::Could not read the minimum Kubernetes version from kubeVersion."
  exit 1
fi

if [[ "$(printf '%s\n' "$minimum" "$KUBERNETES_NEWEST" | sort -V | head -1)" != "$minimum" ]]; then
  echo "::error::KUBERNETES_NEWEST ($KUBERNETES_NEWEST) is older than the chart's minimum ($minimum). Raise it."
  exit 1
fi

# Without this, a version with no published schemas fails every
# example with a message that hides the cause.
for version in "$minimum" "$KUBERNETES_NEWEST"; do
  if ! probe=$(printf 'apiVersion: v1\nkind: ConfigMap\nmetadata:\n  name: probe\n' |
       kubeconform -strict -kubernetes-version "$version" -schema-location "$K8S_SCHEMAS" - 2>&1); then
    echo "::error::Could not load the Kubernetes $version schemas from the pinned kubernetes-json-schema commit: ${probe//$'\n'/ }"
    exit 1
  fi
done

failed=0
for version in "$minimum" "$KUBERNETES_NEWEST"; do
  for f in charts/n8n/examples/*.yaml; do
    echo "Validating $f against Kubernetes $version"
    if ! helm template test charts/n8n -f "$f" --kube-version "$version" |
         kubeconform -strict -summary \
           -kubernetes-version "$version" \
           -schema-location "$K8S_SCHEMAS" \
           -schema-location "$CRD_SCHEMAS" -; then
      echo "::error file=$f::$f does not validate against Kubernetes $version."
      failed=1
    fi
  done
done

exit "$failed"

install-test.name: install-test (${{ matrix.example }}${{ matrix.n8n != 'appVersion' && format(', n8n {0}', matrix.n8n) || '' }})

steps.name: Create Secrets and start Postgres and Redis
steps.run: bash charts/n8n/ci/prepare-cluster.sh

steps.name: Prepare the cluster for ${{ matrix.example }}.yaml
steps.run: bash "charts/n8n/ci/install/${EXAMPLE}.pre.sh"

steps.name: Install chart with ${{ matrix.example }}.yaml on n8n ${{ matrix.n8n }}
steps.run:
image=()
if [[ "$N8N" != "appVersion" ]]; then
  image=(--set "image.tag=${N8N}")
fi
helm install n8n charts/n8n \
  -f "charts/n8n/examples/${EXAMPLE}.yaml" \
  -f "charts/n8n/ci/install/${EXAMPLE}.yaml" \
  "${image[@]}" \
  --wait --timeout 300s

steps.name: Run helm test
steps.run: helm test n8n

steps.name: Check ${{ matrix.example }}.yaml against the cluster
steps.run: bash "charts/n8n/ci/install/${EXAMPLE}.post.sh"

steps.name: Show cluster state
steps.run:
kubectl get pods -o wide
kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -30
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=n8n --all-containers --tail=100 || true

steps.name: Create Secrets and start Postgres and Redis
steps.run: bash charts/n8n/ci/prepare-cluster.sh

steps.name: Prepare the cluster for ${{ matrix.example }}.yaml
steps.run: bash "charts/n8n/ci/install/${EXAMPLE}.pre.sh"

steps.name: Find the last release of the previous major
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
major=$(jq -r '."charts/n8n"' previous/.release-please-manifest.json | cut -d. -f1)
version=$(helm show chart "$CHART_REPO" --version "${major}.x" | sed -n 's/^version: //p')
echo "Upgrading from chart ${version}."
echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Install chart ${{ steps.previous.outputs.version }} with its ${{ matrix.example }}.yaml
steps.run:
helm install n8n "$CHART_REPO" --version "$VERSION" \
  -f "${PREVIOUS}/examples/${EXAMPLE}.yaml" \
  -f "${PREVIOUS}/ci/install/${EXAMPLE}.yaml" \
  --wait --timeout 300s

steps.name: Record the release before the upgrade
steps.run: bash charts/n8n/ci/upgrade/resources.sh snapshot n8n "$RUNNER_TEMP/before.json"

steps.name: Upgrade with the unmigrated values
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
files=("${PREVIOUS}/examples/${EXAMPLE}.yaml" "${PREVIOUS}/ci/install/${EXAMPLE}.yaml")
# Captured first, because a failure inside < <(...) would read as
# an empty list and skip the check.
keys=$(bash charts/n8n/ci/upgrade/retired-keys.sh charts/n8n "${files[@]}")
mapfile -t retired < <(printf '%s' "$keys" | sed '/^$/d')
echo "The unmigrated ${EXAMPLE}.yaml sets these retired keys: ${retired[*]:-none}"

if output=$(helm upgrade n8n charts/n8n -f "${files[0]}" -f "${files[1]}" --dry-run 2>&1); then
  if [[ ${#retired[@]} -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "::error::helm upgrade accepted the unmigrated ${EXAMPLE}.yaml, which sets ${retired[*]}."
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "helm upgrade accepts the unmigrated ${EXAMPLE}.yaml."
  exit 0
fi
echo "$output"

failed=0
for key in "${retired[@]}"; do
  if ! grep -qF " ${key} is no longer a chart value." <<< "$output"; then
    echo "::error::helm upgrade failed on the unmigrated ${EXAMPLE}.yaml without naming ${key}."
    failed=1
  fi
done

# n8n.validate reports one problem as the error itself and several
# as a list.
if grep -q 'problems in your values:$' <<< "$output"; then
  problems=$(sed -n 's/^- //p' <<< "$output")
else
  problems=$(sed -n 's/^Error: \(UPGRADE FAILED: \)\{0,1\}\(execution error at ([^)]*): \)\{0,1\}//p' <<< "$output")
fi
while IFS= read -r problem; do
  if [[ -n "$problem" && "$problem" != *" is no longer a chart value. "* ]]; then
    echo "::error::The unmigrated ${EXAMPLE}.yaml fails outside n8n.retiredKeys: ${problem}"
    failed=1
  fi
done <<< "$problems"
exit "$failed"

steps.name: Upgrade to this chart with ${{ matrix.example }}.yaml
steps.run:
helm upgrade n8n charts/n8n \
  -f "charts/n8n/examples/${EXAMPLE}.yaml" \
  -f "charts/n8n/ci/install/${EXAMPLE}.yaml" \
  --wait --timeout 300s

steps.name: Check the upgrade recreated nothing and rolled once
steps.run: bash charts/n8n/ci/upgrade/resources.sh compare n8n "$RUNNER_TEMP/before.json"

steps.name: Run helm test
steps.run: helm test n8n

steps.name: Check ${{ matrix.example }}.yaml against the cluster
steps.run: bash "charts/n8n/ci/install/${EXAMPLE}.post.sh"

steps.name: Show cluster state
steps.run:
helm history n8n || true
kubectl get pods -o wide
kubectl get events --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -30
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=n8n --all-containers --tail=100 || true

steps.name: Check the other jobs
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

failed=0

for job in "gate:$GATE" "lint:$LINT" "unittest:$UNITTEST" "template-validation:$TEMPLATES" "migrate-values:$MIGRATE" "kubeconform:$KUBECONFORM" "security-scan:$SECURITY"; do
  if [[ "${job#*:}" != "success" ]]; then
    echo "::error::${job%%:*} did not pass, it was ${job#*:}."
    failed=1
  fi
done

# install-test is allowed to be skipped, but only where the gate said
# it was not needed. Skipped on a PR that needed it is a failure.
if [[ "$INSTALL_REQUIRED" == "true" && "$INSTALL" != "success" ]]; then
  echo "::error::install-test had to pass on this pull request, but it was $INSTALL."
  failed=1
fi

if [[ "$UPGRADE_REQUIRED" == "true" && "$UPGRADE" != "success" ]]; then
  echo "::error::upgrade-test had to pass on this pull request, but it was $UPGRADE."
  failed=1
fi

if [[ "$failed" == "1" ]]; then
  exit 1
fi

echo "All required jobs passed (install-test: $INSTALL, required: ${INSTALL_REQUIRED:-false}; upgrade-test: $UPGRADE, required: ${UPGRADE_REQUIRED:-false})."

pipelines.name: Preview chart

steps.name: Resolve preview version
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if ! [[ "$BUILD" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::build must be a positive integer, got '$BUILD'"
  exit 1
fi
BASE=$(helm show chart charts/n8n | awk '$1=="version:"{print $2}')
if [[ "$BASE" == *-* ]]; then
  echo "::error::chart version '$BASE' is already a prerelease; expected a plain release version"
  exit 1
fi
echo "version=${BASE}-preview.workerpools.${BUILD}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Lint and render
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
helm lint charts/n8n
for f in charts/n8n/examples/*.yaml; do
  helm template preview charts/n8n -f "$f" --dry-run=client > /dev/null
done
helm template preview charts/n8n \
  -f charts/n8n/examples/minimal.yaml \
  -f charts/n8n/ci/workerGroups-values.yaml --dry-run=client > /dev/null

steps.name: Log in to GHCR
steps.run:
echo "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | \
  helm registry login ghcr.io -u ${{ github.actor }} --password-stdin

steps.name: Package and push
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
helm package charts/n8n --version "$CHART_VERSION" --destination /tmp/chart-pkg/
helm push "/tmp/chart-pkg/n8n-${CHART_VERSION}.tgz" "$OCI_REPOSITORY"

steps.name: Summary
steps.run:
{
  echo "### Preview chart published"
  echo
  echo "\`${CHART_VERSION}\` from \`${GITHUB_SHA:0:7}\`"
  echo
  echo "Worker pools are an experimental n8n feature and need n8n 2.39.0 or newer."
  echo
  echo '```'
  echo "helm install n8n ${OCI_REPOSITORY}/n8n \\"
  echo "  --version ${CHART_VERSION} \\"
  echo "  -f worker-pools.yaml"
  echo '```'
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

pipelines.name: Release

steps.name: Log in to GHCR
steps.run:
echo "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | \
  helm registry login ghcr.io -u ${{ github.actor }} --password-stdin
echo "${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" | \
  cosign login ghcr.io -u ${{ github.actor }} --password-stdin

steps.name: Package and push to GHCR
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail

helm package charts/n8n --destination /tmp/chart-pkg/
helm push "/tmp/chart-pkg/n8n-${CHART_VERSION}.tgz" oci://ghcr.io/n8n-io/n8n-helm-chart 2>&1 | tee /tmp/push.log

# The chart is signed by digest rather than by tag: a tag can be moved
# to other content later, a digest cannot.
digest=$(awk '$1 == "Digest:" { print $2 }' /tmp/push.log)
if [[ ! "$digest" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::could not read the pushed chart's digest from helm push, so there is nothing to sign."
  exit 1
fi
echo "digest=$digest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Sign the chart
steps.run: cosign sign --yes "$CHART"

steps.name: Verify the signature
steps.run:
cosign verify "$CHART" \
  --certificate-identity "$IDENTITY" \
  --certificate-oidc-issuer https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com \
  > /dev/null
